tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions, so internal hosts are not exempt and plain HTTP is not used for them. Certificate verification stays on in all builds, dev builds included.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

- "https everywhere, no exceptions" (#24), which supersedes it.

I used the later one and left the plain-HTTP option out of the file. The certificate-verification line comes from decision #22.
